description: This file defines a class Env that provides access to environment variables, specifically retrieving the 'API_BASE_URL' with a default fallback. It utilizes the flutter_dotenv package to load environment variables.

classes.name: Env
classes.description: Provides access to environment variables with default values where necessary.

methods.name: apiBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the value of the 'API_BASE_URL' environment variable or a default URL if not set.
